description.narrative: Health guarantee in cooperation with USAID in order to increase access to financing for the private sector health facilities. Target: Financing of equipment and clinic expansion, partly in rural areas.
Hälsogaranti i samarbete med USAID för att möjliggöra satsningar inom privata sektorn för hälsa. Inriktning: Finansiering av utrustning och utbyggnad av kliniker, delvis i rurala områden.

In 2013 Sida together with USAID entered into a guarantee agreement with Ecobank Uganda. The guarantee contribution consists of two parts, a guarantee agreement nr. 617-DCA-13-019, PLANIT ID 54000169 and a subsidy component PLANIT ID 51180064. The initial budget for the guarantee contribution was USD 4 million. USD 2 million (SEK 20 million) of these is Sida's part and the rest is USAID's. SEK 17.5 million is the amount that was guaranteed by Sida. SEK 2.5 million was initially budgeted to be needed for the subsidy and other administrative costs, however only SEK 672,181,260 of these has been used by Sida for payment of the subsidy in 2013. No more funds have been used since then and will not be further needed. As a result of the guarantee's low utilization and absence of a concrete action plan for expansion in the health sector, Sida and USAID have decided, in dialogue with Ecobank, to terminate the guarantee agreement. A decision on termination of agreement was made under contribution nb 54000169 and signed on 22 February 2018 (decision nb: 18/000825). There are no loans that are covered by the guarantee at the time that decision was taken, meaning that the contribution can be terminated. Both contributions, PLANIT ID 54000169 and ID 51180064 are being terminated.
